name: v0.13.5
body:
## tl;dr
- Add `Error::is_dns()` to identify errors caused by DNS resolution failures.
- Add `ClientBuilder::http1_max_headers(usize)` to configure the maximum number of headers accepted in an HTTP/1 response (default 100).
- Add TLS version to `TlsInfo` extension.
- Fix hickory-dns feature to use `Ipv6AndIpv4` strategy to prefer IPv6.
- Fix sending wrong proxy-auth if multiple proxies intercept a given URL.

## What's Changed
* fix(blocking): preserve version and extensions in TryFrom<http::Request> by @wwhsaber in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3050
* Remove unnecessary clones by @FranciscoTGouveia in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3052
* Add `Referrer` and `Referrer Policy` methods to WASM Request API by @Billy-Sheppard in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3049
* chore(deps): bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3058
* feat: add `Error::is_dns()` to identify DNS resolution failures by @JoakoI98 in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3057
* Fix blocking client timeout panic by @V-Mann-Nick in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3060
* Use `LookupIpStrategy::Ipv6AndIpv4` to actually prefer IPv6 when using `hickory-dns` by @FalkWoldmann in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3063
* feat: Add ClientBuilder::http1_max_headers by @smaeda-ks in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3065
* feat: expose the negotiated TLS version via `TlsInfo` by @dennisameling in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3067
* fix(error): detect timeouts wrapped in body decode errors by @raphaelroshan in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3064
* Remove unnecessary clones and a cast by @FranciscoTGouveia in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3071
* chore(deps): upgrade base64 to 0.23 by @paolobarbolini in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3074
* perf(body): reuse tokio::time::Sleep timer via reset() in ReadTimeoutBody by @spellsaif in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3085
* fix(cookie): avoid cloning store and url on Poll::Pending in ResponseFuture::poll by @spellsaif in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3084
* src/async_impl/request.rs_improved_doc_for_json_fn: by @Athleteg in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3082
* fix: proxy could use wrong credentials if many matched by @seanmonstar in https://github.com/seanmonstar/reqwest/pull/3098
